title: Synthetic-Tabular-Data
summary: A thesis project implementing and comparing several tabular data generation models (eGAN, eVAE, EDDPM, TabDDPM, CTGAN, tVAE) on user-supplied CSV datasets. Its ctGAN and tVAE notebooks vendor and adapt CTGAN's own transformer and data-sampler code, which imports rdt's ClusterBasedNormalizer and OneHotEncoder directly, so SDV's CTGAN source and the standalone rdt transformer package are copied in-tree and modified to run the model.
